timeline.summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management received an exchange clarification request regarding a news report on the Yes Bank investment case.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹738.73 Cr (+30.4% YoY), net profit ₹384.72 Cr (+28.8% YoY).
Q4FY26 investor presentation (consolidated): revenue ₹738.7 Cr (+30% YoY), PAT ₹384.7 Cr (+29% YoY), QAAUM ₹7,250 bn (+30% YoY), FY26 dividend ₹21.50 per share.
Nippon Life India AMC filed the monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26 showing ₹399.68 Cr utilized out of ₹588.85 Cr IPO proceeds.
Nippon Life India Asset Management uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 and FY26 earnings call.
Nippon Life India Asset Management reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹7.39 bn and PAT of ₹3.85 bn.

Nippon Life India AMC reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹767 Cr (+26% YoY) and a highest-ever quarterly PAT of ₹504 Cr (+27% YoY), with MF market share at 9.04%, highest since June 2019, and raised FY27 expense growth guidance to 18-20% ex-ESOP.
Nippon Life India AMC reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹796 Cr (+21% YoY) and PAT of ₹324 Cr (+2% YoY), impacted by a ₹97 Cr one-time settlement with SEBI over past Yes Bank AT-1 bond investments.
Nippon Life India Asset Management Limited’s Board declared interim dividend of ₹9.50 per share with record date October 28, 2026, and payment from November 5, 2026.

Nippon Life India AMC's Q2FY27 investor presentation showed revenue up 21% YoY to ₹796 Cr and core operating profit up 25%, but PAT fell 6% YoY to ₹324 Cr after a ₹96.8 Cr exceptional item and a 37% fall in other income.
Nippon Life India AMC filed its Q2FY27 statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32 reporting nil deviations in IPO fund utilization.
